properties.description: Built 2026-10-21 (phase 7 PR 2). A standing section in the instructions every project is served (getting-started/AGENTS.md, "When you say something is not in the design, say where you looked", read through get_instructions): a claim that the design holds nothing about something names which designs, kinds of record, searches and records it checked; on a hub, a plain search names the pinned designs it skipped and `tracked_designs: true` searches them; before writing into a design with relatives, search them together and open and cite a sibling's record rather than write a second copy. The hub skill's step 2.3 names search_design with tracked_designs (one ranked list, prefixed ids get_node opens, not_searched with state), and its "search before you create" bullet runs it across the family (a local hub: tracked_designs; a server's hub: its address; several addresses: one search per design), cites a sibling's settled or brainstormed hit by node id, and says which designs were searched before saying something is not there. Realizes req:a-claim-that-the-design-holds-nothing-says-where-it-was-checked and the agent-side half of req:one-search-reaches-every-design-a-hub-tracks.
properties.name: The served instructions and the hub skill tell the agent to search every design a hub tracks before writing, to read and cite a sibling's precedent, and to say where it looked whenever it says something is not there
